map.Gy 与 Sv 能混用吗？: Can Gy and Sv Be Used Interchangeably?
map.→ 打开由沉积能量与质量求吸收剂量工具: -> Open the Absorbed Dose from Deposited Energy and Mass tool
map.不能，Gy 描述沉积能量，Sv 描述生物危害当量，仅 γ/β（Q=1）时数值相等: No. Gy describes deposited energy while Sv describes the biological hazard equivalent; the values are equal only for γ/β (Q=1).
map.单位 Gy（J/kg）的剂量测算。: Dose estimation in units of Gy (J/kg).
map.吸收剂量与当量剂量区别？: What Is the Difference Between Absorbed Dose and Dose Equivalent?
map.吸收剂量是能量/质量（Gy）；当量剂量再乘辐射权重因子 Q（Sv），见 dose: Absorbed dose is energy per mass (Gy); the dose equivalent multiplies it by the radiation weighting factor Q (Sv), as shown under dose-equivalent.
map.对比不同质量下的剂量强度。: Compare the dose intensity at different masses.
map.由初始与现存活度求年龄: Finding the Age from the Initial and Current Activity
map.由半衰期与原子核数求活度: Activity from Half-Life and Nucleus Count
map.由沉积能量与质量求吸收剂量 使用指南: Absorbed Dose from Deposited Energy and Mass Guide
map.辐射沉积能量 E 除以物质质量 m 得吸收剂量。: The deposited radiation energy E divided by the mass m of the material gives the absorbed dose.
map.输入沉积能量 E 与质量 m，求吸收剂量。: Enter the deposited energy E and the mass m to find the absorbed dose.
map.输入电离辐射在物质中的沉积能量 E 与受照质量 m，按 D = E / m 计算: Enter the deposited energy E of ionising radiation in the material and the irradiated mass m, then compute the absorbed dose from D = E / m (gray Gy), for radiation protection dose estimation and radiotherapy physics calculations.
map.：吸收剂量 D = 0.05 / 1 = 0.05 Gy；若质量减到 0.5kg: : the absorbed dose D = 0.05 / 1 = 0.05 Gy; reducing the mass to 0.5 kg gives D=0.1 Gy, since the same energy is more concentrated.
